messages.content: ترجم الوحدات الإنجليزية إلى عربية فصحى أمينة. أخرج كائن JSON فقط بهذا الشكل: {"book_code":"2ES","verses":[{"chapter":1,"verse":1,"text_ar":"النص المترجم","review_notes_ar":[]}]}. انسخ أرقام الفصل والآية كما هي، وعنصراً واحداً لكل وحدة.

{"verses":[{"text":"The children a year old will speak with their voices. The women with child will deliver premature children at three or four months, and they will live and dance.","chapter":6,"verse":21},{"text":"Suddenly the sown places will appear unsown. The full storehouses will suddenly be found empty.","chapter":6,"verse":22},{"text":"The trumpet will give a sound which when every man hears, they will suddenly be afraid.","chapter":6,"verse":23},{"text":"At that time friends will make war against one another like enemies. The earth will stand in fear with those who dwell in it. The springs of the fountains will stand still, so that for three hours they won’t flow.","chapter":6,"verse":24},{"text":"“It will be that whoever remains after all these things that I have told you of, he will be saved and will see my salvation, and the end of my world.","chapter":6,"verse":25},{"text":"They will see the men who have been taken up, who have not tasted death from their birth. The heart of the inhabitants will be changed and turned into a different spirit.","chapter":6,"verse":26},{"text":"For evil will be blotted out and deceit will be quenched.","chapter":6,"verse":27},{"text":"Faith will flourish. Corruption will be overcome, and the truth, which has been so long without fruit, will be declared.”","chapter":6,"verse":28},{"text":"When he talked with me, behold, little by little, the place I stood on rocked back and forth.","chapter":6,"verse":29},{"text":"He said to me, “I came to show you these things tonight.","chapter":6,"verse":30},{"text":"If therefore you will pray yet again, and fast seven more days, I will again tell you greater things than these.","chapter":6,"verse":31},{"text":"For your voice has surely been heard before the Most High. For the Mighty has seen your righteousness. He has also seen your purity, which you have maintained ever since your youth.","chapter":6,"verse":32},{"text":"Therefore he has sent me to show you all these things, and to say to you, ‘Believe, and don’t be afraid!","chapter":6,"verse":33},{"text":"Don’t be hasty to think vain things about the former times, that you may not hasten in the latter times.’”","chapter":6,"verse":34},{"text":"It came to pass after this, that I wept again, and fasted seven days in like manner, that I might fulfill the three weeks which he told me.","chapter":6,"verse":35},{"text":"On the eighth night, my heart was troubled within me again, and I began to speak in the presence of the Most High.","chapter":6,"verse":36},{"text":"For my spirit was greatly aroused, and my soul was in distress.","chapter":6,"verse":37},{"text":"I said, “O Lord, truly you spoke at the beginning of the creation, on the first day, and said this: ‘Let heaven and earth be made,’ and your word perfected the work.","chapter":6,"verse":38},{"text":"Then the spirit was hovering, and darkness and silence were on every side. The sound of man’s voice was not yet there.","chapter":6,"verse":39},{"text":"Then you commanded a ray of light to be brought out of your treasuries, that your works might then appear.","chapter":6,"verse":40}],"chapter":6,"book_code":"2ES"}
